text: (( • )) ROGERAI · American AI research + infrastructure Tune in to the world’s decentralized Models . Sovereign inference that runs on your hardware or someone else’s through a privatized network. RogerAI is two things. A network where people share specialized open AI models from their own computers and anyone can use them, per token or free. And a lab that trains specialized small Wave models and opens them to users to fine-tune for private use. One OpenAI-compatible local endpoint, on your own machine Routing, failover and metering across community and private hardware Signed receipts for what you paid Read the receipts → ROGERAI LABS THE WAVE SPECTRUM PICO ON AIR · NANO FIRE ON AIR FIG. 1 - TUNE IN roger is one small program.
